Python3-H001 Basics
Case Sensitivity in Python



Python is a case sensitive programming language. Hence the following program will result in the error "NameError: name 'firstname' is not defined"

firstName = "ABCDEF"
print (firstname)

The error is caused as N is in upper case in firstName and is in smaller case in firstname.

The valid program is either

firstName = "ABCDEF"
print (firstName)

or

firstname = "ABCDEF"
print (firstname)
